name: source
help:
usage: work source [-h] {capture,read,validate} ...

positional arguments:
  {capture,read,validate}

options:
  -h, --help  Return command help in a JSON response.

children.name: capture
children.help:
usage: work source capture [-h] --input-file INPUT_FILE --payload-file PAYLOAD_FILE [--approved-sha256 APPROVED_SHA256]

options:
  -h, --help  Return command help in a JSON response.
  --input-file INPUT_FILE  Host-provided capture metadata JSON.
  --payload-file PAYLOAD_FILE  Original source bytes.
  --approved-sha256 APPROVED_SHA256  Approve the exact metadata, payload and project root.

children.name: read
children.help:
usage: work source read [-h] --requirement-id REQUIREMENT_ID --source-id SOURCE_ID

options:
  -h, --help  Return command help in a JSON response.
  --requirement-id REQUIREMENT_ID
  --source-id SOURCE_ID

children.name: validate
children.help:
usage: work source validate [-h] --requirement-id REQUIREMENT_ID --source-id SOURCE_ID

options:
  -h, --help  Return command help in a JSON response.
  --requirement-id REQUIREMENT_ID
  --source-id SOURCE_ID
